title: Integrability of Gaussian linear functionals
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every continuous real linear functional $L:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$, the function $L$ is integrable with respect to the product standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a continuous real linear functional on $\mathbb R^n$
replaced: Let $\gamma_n$ be standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^n$ and $X,Y$ independent with that law. Every continuous real linear functional $L:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ is $\gamma_n$-integrable.
